subject: Re: Terms recast & addendum coordination for expansion - Acapela upsell
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acapela.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@acapela.io>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Terms recast & addendum coordination for expansion

Hi team,

Following our renewal conversation last week, Acapela is planning a significant capacity uplift (+45% tokens/month) and wants a shorter committed term (24 months instead of 36) with a step-down pricing schedule after month 12. Attached is the latest Order Form (Acapela_OrderForm_v3.docx) and the MSA redline we received from their GC.

Ask: can Redwood legal review the proposed term recast and the proposed Exhibit D (usage caps + burst policy) and flag any material obligations we should push back on? Key items to reconcile:
- Term length shift from 36 -> 24 with automatic renewal language (we should preserve renewal notice windows).
- Pricing step-down: they want a 10% reduction in unit price after 12 months; we typically only allow step ups for committed expansion.
- Data residency / audit clause: they added a stronger audit right tied to logged requests.

Ben / Lauren — please call out top commercial trade-offs so I can negotiate while legal iterates.

Attachments: Acapela_OrderForm_v3.docx (draft), redlines_acapela_v2.pdf (their annotated MSA).

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acapela.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@acapela.io>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Terms recast & addendum coordination for expansion

Marissa — thanks for the packet. Quick commercial notes before legal locks language: 

1) Term change: If we go to 24 months, we should require a higher minimum commitment (monthly committed tokens) or a blended price to protect economics. Otherwise it materially lowers our ARR visibility.
2) Step-down pricing after 12 months: can we offer a conditional discount tied to their attainment of the higher usage band (i.e., only if they sustain the +45% for two consecutive quarters)?
3) Billing cadence: confirm they accept monthly invoice with 30-day NET. If they push to quarterly prepay, that's fine but we need to adjust the payment terms for credits.

If legal thinks the audit clause is too broad, I suggest we propose a scoped audit cadence (once per 12 months) and a mutual confidentiality protocol.

I looped Lauren for legal play. I'll handle the commercial counter-proposal once we have legal guidance.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acapela.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@acapela.io>, LegalOps <legalops@acapela.io>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Terms recast & addendum coordination for expansion

Thanks Marissa and Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround. We heard you on protecting Redwood economics; our GC's asks are primarily driven by our internal compliance and procurement committee. Couple of clarifications from our side: 

- The 24-month term is critical to our board's forecast; we can discuss a 36-month option but that's not their preference.
- The step-down pricing isn't unconditional — it's proposed to reflect the guaranteed uplift; they included a two-quarter sustain requirement in the attached redline (redlines_acapela_v2.pdf).
- Audit request: we can narrow it to a SOC-adjacent data access review rather than live access to logs. Our LegalOps contact (copied) can take legal redlines and give a clean marked-up MSA.

We've attached a single consolidated PDF with commentary. Can Redwood legal propose specific language for: (A) short-term notice/renewal clause compatible with 24-months; (B) conditional pricing step tied to usage bands; (C) scoped audit language (frequency, purpose, and redaction).

Samantha
Samantha Lee | Head of IT Procurement
Acapela Health
Attachments: redlines_acapela_v2.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acapela.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@acapela.io>
Date: 2026-10-20T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Terms recast & addendum coordination for expansion

Team — consolidated ask below and a proposed path to close this week: 

1) Legal: please review the attached redlines and propose alternate language for: renewal notice window (we typically want 60-90 days), conditional discount mechanics, and a scoped audit clause (once per 12 months; access to aggregated logs and metadata only; mutually agreed vendor auditor).
2) Commercial (Ben): propose a blended two-year price that preserves year-1 economics and offers a performance-based rebate in year-2 (instead of an unconditional step-down).
3) External (Acapela): if you can produce a marked-up Order Form that shows the committed token tiers per month we can map discounts to attainment thresholds.

I'll draft a redlined Order Form that merges Ben's blended approach with their proposed sustain condition and circulate once Lauren confirms legal language. Need to get to a signable package by Friday EOD.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@acapela.io>
Date: 2026-10-21T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Terms recast & addendum coordination for expansion

Marissa / Ben / Samantha — Legal has reviewed Acapela's redlines and I attached an MSA comparison table (MSA_Comparison_Table.xlsx) with three recommended positions: 

A) Term & Renewal: Accept 24-month firm term with a single auto-renew for 12 months unless either party provides 90 days' written notice prior to expiration. We propose a minimum committed token floor for the shorter term; language in the spreadsheet suggests how to formulaically calculate the floor.

B) Pricing Step: Replace unconditional step-down with a conditional rebate payable at the end of month 12 if Acapela attains the agreed uplift for two consecutive fiscal quarters. Rebate mechanics are in the spreadsheet (credit vs. true-up payment).

C) Audit Scope: Limit to one annual compliance review; Redwood provides aggregated metadata samples and a written attestation. If a third-party audit is requested, it will be subject to mutual selection of auditor and reasonable scoping/time.

I marked the clauses that are material and recommended negotiation positions. If Acapela accepts A-C in principle, Ben and Marissa can finalize commercial terms and I will cleanly mark the MSA and Order Form for signatures.

Attachments: MSA_Comparison_Table.xlsx

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
